'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Brian Fred LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: SYCFA... what the fuck were they thinking?. Transcription note: header "Deck title: The Fishfleas Deck" (first word struck); bottom note "It could be WIRFS!"

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' retwin316
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
